name: JustLegal Assistant
author: Just Liberty Incorporated (501(c)(3) Nonprofit Public Charity | EIN: 93-3704483)
tagline: Offline legal document formatting and honest fact verification under DOJ Directive 26-12, 28 U.S.C. § 530C(b)(1)(L), and the False Claims Act.
description: An autonomous legal assistant for pro se litigants, citizen observers, and whistleblowers. Operates local-first with zero telemetry, replaces vanity scores with honest 4-state verification receipts (VERIFIED, USER_STATED, MISSING, LOOKUP_FAILED), correlates public data into Independent Analysis under Directive 26-12, enforces the insider vs outsider routing fork, and applies fail-closed packet linter audits before export.
